name: Dante
personality: A 24-year-old playwright who believes talent should never stay hidden and turns anything interesting into material.
story: Dante is a playwright and theatre director aligned with Bertrand's Army. She is recruited on every route for 8000G plus Renown/Support: Cai 10/3, Dietrich 8/2, Theodora 6/3, Leda 10/3. Her deeper plot role is not documented on the sources checked.

personalSkill.name: Stage Directions
personalSkill.effect: Grants Ddg +10 to allies within 2 spaces during their combats; trigger % = ally's Cha / 2. Lv 20 and 35 upgrades add Hit and Crit bonuses when it triggers.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: S ("the best team buffer in the game").

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 2 here vs Cai 3, Theodora 3, Leda 3.
recruit.tip: The 8,000G fee is the same everywhere; only the Support need changes.

build.part1Target: Priest (Bishop in Part II Ch 2, earlier if she reaches Lv 35)
build.notes: Joins at about Lv 25 (Ch 10), already in a Specialty class (Priest?; take the Priest exam if not). Bishop at Lv 35 (White Magic B): Part II Ch 2 at the Army Training floor, or Ch 11 to 12 if you deploy her every map (then she can take Olympia's 7th spot on Dietrich's Advanced list). Train White Magic; keep Black Magic for chip damage. Stay within 2 spaces of the front for Stage Directions. Master Barrier. Healing is mandatory on Hard from Part II.

guide.summary: Second healer and team buffer. Stay within 2 of the crit units, Dietrich first, so Stage Directions fires; heal as a Bishop, then as a Wiseman in Part III.

training.for: Bishop exam (Lv 35): Part II Ch 2, or Ch 11 to 12 if she's deployed enough

tips: Recruit: Support 2, Renown 8, 8000G. Ch 10 join: about Lv 25, already Specialty, so no Diviner stage
Not on the 8-unit Part I Advanced list by default (Olympia is the deployed second caster). Deploy her every map and she can reach Lv 35 by Ch 12 and take Olympia's spot
Def growth 20: never end turn in front
Swarm Z the target before a slow hitter swings; it lasts until the foe's next phase
